title: sqliteInput
responsibility: Builds ordered, SQLite-ready column and binding pairs from a partial model input.

inputs.name: sqliteInput.model
inputs.description: The SqliteModel whose fields map is the only part this function reads: it supplies the accepted property names, each field's optional column override, and each field's type and nullable flag. The table and primaryKey members are not read here, and a key is accepted only when model.fields has it as an own property holding a field definition.

inputs.name: sqliteInput.input
inputs.description: The partial record to bind, keyed by model property: keys it does not contain are skipped, and each key it does contain must name a field in model.fields whose value binds for that field's type. An undefined value never binds, and null becomes SQL NULL only for nullable fields, while a non-nullable json field binds it as the text null and any other non-nullable field rejects it.
inputs.unknownReason: Each property has the runtime type declared by its SQLite model field.

outputs.name: sqliteInput
outputs.description: One entry per input key, in the order Object.entries returns, with a column that is the double-quoted column name (field.column, or the snake_case form of the property when no column is declared) and a value that is the string, number, Uint8Array or null produced by sqliteBinding (booleans become 0 or 1 and json values become JSON text). The first key that fails throws, so the array is never partial.

errors.name: Unknown SQLite field or invalid binding
errors.description: Thrown when a key is not an own property of model.fields holding a field definition (message Unknown SQLite field: <property>), when the column name (field.column, or the snake_case property) is not an identifier of ASCII letters, digits and underscores that starts with a letter or underscore (message Invalid SQLite identifier: <name>), or when a value does not bind for its field type (message Invalid SQLite <type> field value). The first failing key aborts the whole call.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown by JSON.stringify inside sqliteBinding when a json field value is circular or includes a bigint anywhere inside it, and the TypeError propagates out of sqliteInput unchanged.
